changelog: First non-canonical public MVP preview. Publishes the reviewed ancient hard-case vertical slice without changing the canonical v0.6.1 data release.
qc_summary: 11/11 claims reviewed; 11/11 have claim-specific source links; every spatial target has reviewed exact/specialist/approximate/unresolved geometry coverage for the claim interval; 0 invalid PostGIS geometries.
unresolved_issues: Mycenaean combined archive target has explicitly unresolved territorial geometry. Achaemenid Persis/Elam uses an approximate historical imperial proxy. Shang, Mycenaean and Achaemenid slavery classifications retain disputed status where recorded. This preview is not a canonical data release.
